title: Second Marine squadmate reaches out via LinkedIn
summary: Michael Herrera tells of Second Marine squadmate reaches out via LinkedIn, about 2024 at an unknown place, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: Keep the faith. there is nothing, no borders lines that they won't cross.

plain: Michael Herrera, a former US Marine who says he saw a huge craft, about 300 feet across, in the Indonesian jungle, tells podcast host Jesse Michels that in 2024 a second man from his old squad contacted him on LinkedIn, a website for work contacts. He shares their texts and emails, in which the other Marine warns him to keep the faith because there are no lines the people behind it won't cross. He tells it because a second squadmate speaking up would back his story.
